evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and directly modifies depends package recipes and patches under depends/packages/capnp.mk and depends/patches/capnp/.
rationale: Fixes false-positive data races in ThreadSanitizer debug assertion builds of Cap'n Proto. PR description notes 'The TSan job builds capnp without optimization, which automatically enables these assertions, and TSan reports these reads as data races', resolving CI failures and unblocking libmultiprocess#376.
